main_text.p: Cafei bo-Cafeum omnem ægrè confici, fuccosque ni maligimprobos fubminiftrare, ventriculum flatibus replere, multorum erronea opinio eft. figna.Recentes enim laxiores & molliores, ex dul-ci, bono, laudabilíque lacte, butyro non fe-parato, confectos, ac puriores, aliis videlicet fuccis aut rebus non commixtis, induratis ac veteribus in cibis præferri debere omnia pene confenfu traditur. Immodico quoque fale imbuti cafei improbantur, & qui nullo pariter noxii funt: humore deftituti vetufta-teque corrupti, putres quoque vermibusq; fcatentes pernitiofiffimi funt: acriores & ca-lidiores certum eft difficulter concoqui. Ve-teres, fi in frequentiorem cibatum admiffi fuerint, animæ grauitatem afferre, complu-ribus experimentis percognitum eft. Verum facilè ex iis,quæ de lacte fuerunt prodita,iu-dicare eft,quinam præftantiores,& qui igno-biliores fint. Operofiffimum enim effero-mnium regionum & tractuum dotes perfe-qui. Nominatiffimi funt hodie,quos mittit Hollandia, Helvetica, Mediolanum, quos placentinos appellant,nec non Weftphalia. Suecia & fuos miris effert laudibus, & certe eft Parmenfibus parum cedere. In feptem-trionis quibusdam tractibus certum eft ca-feos in tantam ab incolis molem cogi atque denfari,vt vni ferendo vix quatuor robuf-timi bajuli sufficiant. Soli autem ratio pluri-mum

page.notes: Left-margin notes "Cafei bo-", "ni malig" and "figna." are fragments, cut off at the edge of the scan; their completion is unclear. "fe-parato" and "Helvetica"/"Weftphalia" are uncertain readings from the scan, and the word after "figna." is partly obscured. "Cafeum" at the top is read as the start of a sentence, so the paragraph probably continues from the previous page. The line ending "pluri-" continues on the final line with "mum", which may be a catchword or the end of the word. Some lines near the edge and the right margin are cut off and could not be read fully.
